markdown-clip.copyAsHtml.title: Convert to HTML and Copy to clipboard
markdown-clip.configuration.removeHeadin: Remove heading IDs added during rendering from copied HTML. Explicit IDs assigned by Markdown-it plugins are preserved. This does not affect the preview.
markdown-clip.configuration.removeVSCode: Remove VS Code's data-line attribute and code-line class from copied HTML. Other classes and dir='auto' are preserved. This does not affect the preview.
markdown-clip.configuration.markdown-it-: If you specify a custom attribute (in the form {#id .class}), it will be applied to the HTML tag.
